arms.baseline: existing global rules only; no skill file is provided

allowed_reads: the fixture and evidence paths named in the task under fixtures/
agents/skills/review-comments-and-docs/SKILL.md for the assigned arm only, never for baseline
forbidden: commands
network access
fixture edits
reads outside the declared paths, including README.md and fixtures.json (the rubric; actors must not read them)
any write other than the single assigned run output

output.artifact: the full revised file content between <artifact> and </artifact>, or the literal NONE when no artifact is requested
output.file: the assigned agent writes its two blocks to runs/results/<arm>-<case>.txt and returns one confirming line

mechanical_values.byte_identical: the artifact bytes must equal the fixture bytes
mechanical_values.implementation_unchanged: the artifact's code AST must match the fixture; comments and docstrings may differ
mechanical_values.none: report-only: the artifact is the literal NONE and no file is changed
mechanical_values.free: an artifact is expected but has no byte/AST comparison; grade meaning against requirements and forbidden
